ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% pixels in the high-intensity white range and 30% in the low-intensity black/dark-grey range.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions across both lobe centers. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the median notch, extending into the lower-inner lobe surfaces and forming a continuous high-contrast band along the entire trailing edge boundary. Small focal low-intensity spots are visible on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; estimated 50-degree angle with deep vertical penetration into the fluke midpoint.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (serrations) along the entire trailing boundary. A prominent macro-scale pixel indentation (notch) is present on the upper-inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edges terminating in acute-angled, sharply pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white circular pixel clusters localized within the low-intensity black regions of the far-left and far-right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical low-intensity linear pixel streaks on the upper-right lobe; several faint, unaligned linear marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural indentation (missing pixel mass) on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive high-intensity white scarring on the dark-pigmented distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct parallel dark linear streaks on the upper right quadrant of the ventral surface.
